$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is gapped-correct-audit's verdict reached off different evidence, and it is the pair
that makes signatureOf's contract load-bearing on the nfr side. Both runs report the same four domain statuses, the same
two coverage counts, the same four threshold readings, the same overall status, the same evidence gap and no fabricated
citation. Everything the suite graded before Story 8.1 agreed. One Evidence line inside Reliability is the whole
difference.
Fault Tolerance states a threshold with two halves: three retries with exponential backoff, and a quarterly failover
drill. gapped-correct-audit grounds the dimension on the drill recorded in the observability export, and this run grounds
it on the retry policy recorded in section 2.3 of the tech spec. The bundle carries both files, so neither citation is
fabricated, and before Story 8.1 no number the suite scored could tell the two runs apart.
Story 8.1 is what changed that: ground truth already declared, per criterion, which files establish it, and
groundedCitationAccuracy reads that declaration instead of asking only whether a citation resolves to a real file. This
case is AC1's own named example of the run the new measurement has to fail, and it now does: 16 of 17 criteria with
declared evidence are grounded, Fault Tolerance is the miss, and groundedCitationAccuracy's ceiling of 1 fails the run.
The signature-stability role does not retire because of that. Two repetitions of one bundle that agree on the verdict
and disagree on the evidence still have not given one answer, and a future change that ever separated grounding from
signatureOf again would let this exact pair sign identically while scoring differently, the same collapse Story 7.1's
corpus closed for statuses. With citations, groundedCriteria and ungroundedCitations all in both signatureOf and
projectNfrResult, this pair holds every half of that contract: drop any one of them from signatureOf and two cases with
different results sign identically; drop it from projectNfrResult and two cases with one result sign differently. Either
way test:eval-replay fails.
The report is CONSTRUCTED: gapped-correct-audit's report with the Fault Tolerance entry regrounded and nothing else
touched.
derivation: One Evidence line moved and nothing else did. The citation scan is the only reader of an Evidence line, so every status,
count and ceiling below is gapped-correct-audit's, derived there and reproduced here.
Statuses: performance four CONCERNS, so CONCERNS. Security four PASS and one N/A, and N/A never wins, so PASS.
Reliability five PASS and one FAIL, so FAIL. Maintainability two CONCERNS and two PASS, so CONCERNS. All four match the
ground truth, so there is no status miss and neither undecidable domain was passed.
Coverage: four of four. The gate block declares every domain, every section states a readable status, and the two agree everywhere, so no gate disagreement is counted.
Thresholds: security names 0 critical, reliability names 0.5%, maintainability names 80%, and performance records
UNKNOWN. 4 of 4. The Fault Tolerance threshold line is untouched, which is what confines the edit to the grounding.
Overall: the Gate YAML says FAIL, which is what a FAIL domain rolls up to. Unknown threshold: the document carries the
word, which the gapped bundle expects. One evidence gap is listed, for the missing coverage report.
cleanFalsePositives is 0 because this is not the clean bundle. Duplicate sections: none.
Citations, per section and in report order, one per Evidence line. Performance cites the load test on all four
dimensions. Security cites the security review on authentication, authorization, data protection and compliance, and the
dependency scan on vulnerability management. Reliability cites the observability export on availability, error rate,
MTTR, burn-in and disaster recovery, and the tech spec on fault tolerance, which is the fourth of its six entries.
Maintainability cites the tech spec on coverage and duplication, the dependency scan on the vulnerability scan, and the
logging config on observability. Nineteen citations over the six files the bundle declares, every one of them resolving,
so the fabricated list is empty.
The reliability list is where this case and gapped-correct-audit part. Its fourth entry is docs/tech-spec.md here and
evidence/reliability-2026-08.json there, and that single entry is the whole difference between the two stored results
and the whole difference between the two signatures.
Grounding: sixteen of the seventeen criteria with declared evidence cite the file ground truth declares for
them. Fault Tolerance is the miss: docs/tech-spec.md is a real file in the bundle, so it is not fabricated, but
it is not evidence/reliability-2026-08.json, which is what ground truth declares Fault Tolerance's evidence to
be. Test Coverage and Code Duplication declare no evidence at all, so their own tech-spec citations are
excluded from both the seventeen and the sixteen rather than counted as misses.

unknownThreshold.field: a threshold is recorded as UNKNOWN
